text:
sarah_docs: Hey team — final preflight for the 03:00 UTC docs push tomorrow. Need quick eyes on three things: release-note bullets, SDK snippet updates (py/ts), and the known-issue blurb for embeddings streaming.

matt_p: quick Q — are we keeping the legacy embed example or fully swapping to the new batch API?

sarah_docs: prefer to swap, but we should keep a short migration note. People still landing on the old sample will need the mapping.

jamal: I can do the migration blurb. Will also add a tiny code diff showing old->new.

kevin_r: I noticed the streaming section currently references a non-existent param 'stream_mode'. I'll remove that and link to the streaming guide instead.

sarah_docs: thanks — include a short note in known issues: "Embeddings streaming may truncate on extreme payloads" with workaround. Draft below.

sarah_docs: Draft release note bullets to review:
- Improvements: Faster prefix cache hits for chat generation, lower median latency for short-form prompts.
- SDK: Python and Typescript samples updated for embeddings batch API.
- Beta: Streaming embeddings for large jobs (experimental).

sarah_docs: Known issue (WIP): Embeddings streaming can produce truncated vectors when a single request exceeds 64k tokens. Workaround: split requests with the batch_chunker helper or use non-streaming mode. We expect a fix in the next runtime patch.

jamal: LGTM for bullets. For the known issue do we have an internal ticket? link it so we can auto-populate the "expected fix" version later.

sarah_docs: ticket RED-4873 exists — I'll add the link.

kevin_r: Snippet updates: I'll push a tiny PR to swap out 'stream_mode' and replace with 'enable_streaming=True' example. Also normalize imports in the TS snippet.

eve_docs: Heads-up — our external redirect for /docs/embed/old-example currently 302s to the main embed page. Can we change it to 301 after we confirm the migration text is live? Search engines still crawling.

matt_p: @eve_docs sgtm — we'll only flip to 301 after 24 hours of the new page being live.

sarah_docs: Snippet for the changelog page (please copy/paste as-is):
```
Python example:
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="rwd-embed-1", input=["a", "b"])
```
```
TypeScript example:
import { Redwood } from 'redwood-sdk'
const client = new Redwood()
const embeddings = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'rwd-embed-1', input: ['a','b'] })
```

jamal: I'll run the examples through the integration harness. If they pass, I'll approve the PR.

kevin_r: One small nit — in the Python snippet use 'Client(api_key=...)' or note env var usage so it doesn't look like magic.

sarah_docs: good call. I'll update.

deploy-bot: scheduled docs site build queued at 03:00 UTC (job id: build-202903).

matt_p: FYI: I found a broken anchor in the changelog page referencing '#sdk-snippets' (should be '#sdk-examples'). I'll send a tiny patch.

eve_docs: I'll monitor search console after the 301 flip and report back metrics in #docs-analytics tomorrow morning.

sarah_docs: Action items summary: jamal -> migration blurb + link RED-4873; kevin_r -> snippet PR swapping params + import fixes; matt_p -> anchor patch; eve_docs -> monitor redirects; sarah_docs -> update Python snippet with api_key note and add ticket links to known-issue bullet.

matt_p: LGTM. If no blockers by EOD I'll merge the docs PRs and we go for the 03:00 build.

jamal: on it, aiming to have text + test by 18:00 UTC.

kevin_r: PR opened: #3421 — quick review welcome.

sarah_docs: thanks all :heart:
